audit.why: Melee bruiser who owns levels 1-5 on Decimate and Hemorrhage stacks; Aatrox's window opens at 6 with World Ender's heal amp. Existing phase text matches.
Noxian Guillotine (R) is 120/100/80 true damage scaled off Hemorrhage stacks, so it ignores armour entirely. World Ender is 120/100/80 — same cooldown, but his ends fights and yours extends them.
Apprehend (E) is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — the longest cooldown in his kit and the single tool that starts every all-in. Fighting on that cooldown, not on levels, is the matchup.

edits.before: Track his Darius E - Apprehend and Ghost before you commit
edits.after: Track his Apprehend (E) — 26s at rank 1 — before you commit
